'''Sansin Koriss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], who served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. He became one of the three gatekeepers contained within the [[Sith holocron (Tascollan Nebula)|Tascollan holocron]]. His [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] gatekeeper wore long robes and a lot of jewelry.
